heard: Seven Earth-sized planets are crammed inside the orbit of Mercury. They circle a red dwarf barely larger than Jupiter. On the world Trappist 1e, one year lasts just six days. It stays permanently locked, with one side always facing its sun. One half is scorched desert, the other is frozen night. Stellar winds drive currents that heat the planet, slowly stripping away its atmosphere. It remains caught between a paradise and an airless rock. Yet, all seven worlds still fit inside Mercury's orbit.
